concept: EFS: shared NFS file system for many Linux EC2 across multiple AZs
tests: Choosing storage accessible concurrently by hundreds of Linux instances across AZs with automatic scaling.
expected: Amazon EFS — managed elastic NFS, multi-AZ, concurrent access. Triggers: "shared file storage", "concurrently from hundreds of Linux instances", "multiple AZs", "scaling automatically".
why_not: EBS — attached to one instance (Multi-Attach only within one AZ); S3 — object storage, not POSIX; instance store — ephemeral and local.
